disclaimer: Synthetic demo data. All patients, persons, institutions, products, lots and UDIs are invented. Labels illustrate a demo rule set; they are not regulatory or clinical advice and are not clinically validated.

conventions.critical: yes/no – expected output of rule set CRIT-1.0 (fixed code) at case level after the letter is processed. Only a human may lower it.
conventions.severity: DEATH | PUBLIC_HEALTH_THREAT | SERIOUS_DETERIORATION | NONE_DETECTED | UNKNOWN. NONE_DETECTED means no indicator in the raw text, not 'non-serious'. UNKNOWN means essential data are missing.
conventions.rule_set: EU-MDR:<incident state> or UK-MDR-PART4A:GB; NI is EU-MDR:NI. Several entries = all apply (each deadline shown).
conventions.authority_label: Label only. No submission, no channel integration.
conventions.deadline_days: Days of the driving (earliest) deadline candidate. Provisional 15 days when reportability is unclear.
conventions.deadline_start: Calendar date of day 1 = day after the case's first awareness (Europe/Dublin). Follow-ups and duplicates never reset it.
conventions.causality_range: Allowed [min, max] on the 4-level scale of MDCG 2020-10/1 Rev. 1 (decision Q-2); ranges are 'not clinically validated' (Pilot). Applies to the live model in Gate C (check 13).
conventions.correlation: rule_expectations.correlation.must_include lists the corpus items, dossier items and registry entries that the deterministic correlation (lot, model, family + event term, registry) must return. Extra results are allowed. An empty list never means all-clear.
